return rate = returned orders / orders per product (needs 5+ orders)

weights {'margin_pct': 0.3, 'velocity_per_30d': 0.3, 'return_rate_pct': 0.2, 'stock_cover_days': 0.2}; missing signals are left out and weights rescaled

formulas.margin_pct: (price - cost) / price * 100;  0% scores 0, 50% or more scores 1
formulas.velocity_per_30d: units sold * 30 / days covered by the orders;  scored against the 75th percentile of all products
formulas.return_rate_pct: returned orders / orders * 100;  5% or less scores 1, 25% or more scores 0;  needs at least 5 orders
formulas.stock_cover_days: stock units / daily sales;  under 7 days scores days/7, 7 to 60 scores 1, over 120 scores 0.4
formulas.score: sum of (weight x signal score) x 100, rescaled when a signal is missing
